instructions: This is a Next.js (App Router) app on the Kiranism next-shadcn-dashboard-starter, using Convex as the database and Clerk for auth. Every PR targets the `development` branch off a feature branch; nothing is committed directly to `development` or `main`. Convex business logic (mutations/queries) is tested at the function seam with convex-test in *.test.ts files alongside the source — flag new mutations or queries that lack test coverage. Role checks (Admin/Staff) must be enforced server-side inside the Convex function itself, not just hidden in the UI — flag any mutation that trusts a client-supplied role or skips a `ctx.auth.getUserIdentity()` check. Domain vocabulary (Trip, Participant, Registration, Capacity, Payment Status, Registration Status, Activity Log, Admin, Staff) is defined in CONTEXT.md — flag naming that drifts from it (e.g. "Booking" instead of "Registration"). Favor small, focused diffs; flag unnecessary abstractions or speculative generality.
